critical_code_review_comments: Backend routes use `_id: 0` projections consistently in signal_intelligence.py — good.
OpportunitiesView & related /view variants correctly reuse shared _list_opportunities helper (DRY). v14 fix at line 206 (severity=='opportunity') is present and covered by tests.

Uvicorn is run with --reload watching /app/backend — placing test files under /app/backend/tests/ causes reload loops; moved tests to /app/tests to avoid this. Recommend keeping backend integration tests outside /app/backend or adding --reload-exclude tests/ in supervisor config.
